author_review.scope: All 400 item contexts, instructions, prompts, answer keys, alternatives, explanations and 40 skill mappings
checks: Self-contained instructions and scenarios; no course-specific terminology needed
Answer uniqueness within the explicit context
Regional alternatives: no perfecto/indefinido time-marker trap, no ra/se opposition, no leismo trap
Actual section/chapter IDs and machine level; no automatic course releveling
Spanish prompt; Russian context, instruction and explanation
Scenario-family distinction; no automatic name/number substitution
Editorial difficulty explicitly reviewed per skill: 3 direct, 4 standard, 3 additional distinctions
C1 semantic distractors preserve natural wording but change scope, time, certainty or roles
author_review.corrections: Rewrote weak artificial distractors; moved Spanish quotations into prompt and task directions into instruction; corrected one malformed question, command register and reporting roles; replaced mechanical difficulty rotation with explicit comparative editorial labels.

independent_internal_review.followup: All 15 revised items were rechecked by the independent reviewer; no open findings.

user_pilot.audience: Learners who have not read the grammar course

empirical_calibration.note: Difficulty is editorial, not an empirical CEFR calibration.

peer_review_corrections.summary: Removed competing grammatical readings, clarified register and scope, restored explicit source details, removed positional explanations and grammatical metalanguage, improved natural phrasing.
